en.headline: ICAC charges five over technology voucher fraud involving shell companies
en.dek: A technology services provider and four others face conspiracy to defraud charges after an operation intercepted nearly 90 per cent of more than HK$100 million in suspected subsidies.
body: The Independent Commission Against Corruption said on Friday it had charged five people, including a technology services provider, with conspiracy to defraud over the government's Technology Voucher Programme.

According to the ICAC, Kan Cheuk-hong, 36, faces four counts. The other defendants — shell company owners Lai Hau-hei, Brandon Leung Ngo-hin and Cheung Tun-cheung, and middleman Ng Sui-ki, aged 31 to 49 — each face one count. The charges allege they falsely represented companies as eligible applicants that had engaged Kan's firms and paid for services, inducing approval of subsidies exceeding HK$1.6 million between 2019 and 2025.

The ICAC said the providers involved were linked to about 470 applications worth more than HK$100 million. Through Operation Thunder and coordination with the Innovation and Technology Commission and Hong Kong Productivity Council, nearly 90 per cent of the subsidies, about HK$94 million, were intercepted. The case was to be mentioned at Eastern Magistrates' Courts on Friday afternoon. Investigations continue.

zh.headline: 廉署起訴科技服務供應商等5人 涉空殼公司詐騙科技券
zh.dek: 一名科技服務供應商及四名空殼公司負責人與中間人遭控串謀詐騙，廉署指成功阻截近九成涉贎資助。
body: 廉政公署周五表示，已落案起訴五人，包括一名科技服務供應商，指他們涉嫌透過空殼公司詐騙政府科技券計劃資助。
廉署指，36歲科技服務供應商簡焚匡被控四項串謀詐騙罪。其他四名被告分別為空殼公司負責人黎厚希、梁傲顯及張敦翔，以及中間人吳瑞琪，年齡31至49歲，各被控一項。控罪指他們於2019年至2025年間詐稱有關公司符合資格申請資助，並已委聘簡焚匡的公司及支付服務費，誘使當局批出逾160萬元資助。
廉署表示，涉案數間科技服務供應商涉及約470宗申請，總資助額逾一億元。透過「震雷」行動及與創科署、生產力局協調，成功阻截近九成資助，約9400萬元。案件周五下午在東區裁判法院提訊。調查仍在進行。
